conversation_kind_shape_check.name: conversation_kind_shape_check
conversation_kind_shape_check.value: (kind = 'DM' AND user1_id IS NOT NULL AND user2_id IS NOT NULL AND user1_id < user2_id AND lobby_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'LOBBY' AND lobby_id IS NOT NULL AND user1_id IS NULL AND user2_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'ROOM' AND lobby_id IS NULL AND user1_id IS NULL AND user2_id IS NULL)

play_session_scheduled_at_check.name: play_session_scheduled_at_check
play_session_scheduled_at_check.value: (timing_type = 'now' AND scheduled_at IS NULL) OR (timing_type = 'scheduledAt' AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL)

invitation_target_shape_check.name: invitation_target_shape_check
invitation_target_shape_check.value: (target_type = 'ROOM' AND play_session_id IS NULL) OR (target_type = 'PLAY_SESSION' AND play_session_id IS NOT NULL)

recruitment_scheduled_at_check.name: recruitment_scheduled_at_check
recruitment_scheduled_at_check.value: (timing_type = 'now' AND scheduled_at IS NULL) OR (timing_type = 'scheduledAt' AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL)

recruitment_roblox_fields_check.name: recruitment_roblox_fields_check
recruitment_roblox_fields_check.value: (game_title = 'Roblox' AND experience_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(experience_name)) > 0 AND experience_url IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(experience_url)) > 0) OR (game_title <> 'Roblox' AND experience_name IS NULL AND experience_url IS NULL)
